body:
## What it does

Covers EEG and BCI signal interpretation, decoding brain states and intentions, and the OpenBCI-class hardware that produces the signal in the first place. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @monomyth shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
